packet.prompt:
Read only the supplied manuscript images. Do not search for the text, open a
catalogue or edition, or consult an earlier transcription. Do not identify the
work or author. If prior context has already revealed a proposed identification
or reading, stop and report that exposure instead of calling this a blind reading.

Begin with a brief image-only layout survey. Note orientation, columns, running
titles, rubrics, enlarged initials, underlined text, and interlinear or marginal
glosses when visible. Distinguish observations from tentative interpretations
such as main text with commentary. Do not infer author, work, date, or provenance.
A tight crop may not show the layout; say so rather than guessing.

Use those features to choose a few useful spans: headings or question openings,
then connecting prose, transitions or citation chains. Keep quoted lemmata and
commentary separate. Read enough surrounding prose to make a later source match
checkable; a full transcription is not required. State which areas you selected
and which remain unread. Suggest a wider view or an adjacent crop if needed.

Transcribe those spans, preserving physical lines. Label each line with its
image filename and a line number counted from the top of that image. Keep columns
and marginal additions separate. Note overlapping crops rather than treating
repeated lines as additional text.

Retain abbreviation marks when possible. Put proposed expansions in parentheses,
uncertain readings before a question mark, and unreadable text in [illegible].
Describe visible deletions and additions explicitly. Do not supply missing words
from what would make grammatical or philosophical sense. Leave uncertainty visible.

Return the reading as UTF-8 plain text. Include limitations (cropped lines, damage,
uncertain column order) in that same response. This is an unverified image reading.

text:
packet-15 - unverified image reading (first reader)
Exposure: nothing in my context revealed a proposed identification of this record. Blind reading.

== LAYOUT SURVEY, face 1 (overview image-001.jpg) ==
Observations (overview only):
- Dark background, colour checker lower left, cm scale at right edge. Three separate paper fragments, all upright.
- Piece A (upper left/centre): roughly rectangular paper scrap, torn/split vertically near its middle. Two large grey rectangles cover most of its surface (digital masking in the image, not the leaf). Only 3 short lines of faded cursive visible at the top. Pencil shelfmark "Stams, STA, Frg. 182-3a?" lower right.
- Piece B (upper right): paper fragment, ragged torn lower edge, ~10 lines of German cursive (Kurrent-type) in brown ink, long lines running off left and right edges (text cut both sides). Pencil shelfmark written vertically at right edge. No rubrics, no initials.
- Piece C (lower right): paper fragment, Latin in a later humanistic/cursive hand, ~17 lines; left edge cut (line starts lost), right side has a marginal/added block of ~5 short lines enclosed by a vertical line (an addition keyed to the main text). A struck-through word at about line 7 with a word added above. Pencil shelfmark at top. Tentative: scholastic theological prose (philosophical Latin about God and creatures).
- Tile mapping (inferred from tile dimensions): 002-004 top row (left/centre/right), 005-007 middle row, 008-010 bottom row. Piece A should fall in 002/003, Piece B in 003/004, Piece C in 007/010 (+ maybe 006/009).

== image-003.jpg (top-middle tile) ==
Shows right edge of Piece A (left, mostly grey mask; only two word-endings at its top: line 1 "...ui" / "...m~", line 2 "...op" / "...gr?") and the LEFT part of Piece B (German cursive). Piece B lines, left edge of leaf cuts word starts:
003.B01 [..]rnung befunden, vnnd
003.B02 [..]ge ſchreiben Einſtan[...]   (long s; "Einſtan" with large looped E; word continues on next tile)
003.B03 [..]omen wie ich mir b[...]
003.B04 [..]ich die Zeit lang
003.B05 [..]erhalten vnnd gedien[...]
003.B06 [..] 5. Monnath wider[...]   (ink blot before "5"; "5" followed by stroke/period)
003.B07 [..]l beſach, das mir der   (first word "beſach"? or "beſahe"? - reading "beſach")
003.B08 [..]l den H: Quarde b[...]   ("H:" = abbreviation, probably H(err); "Quarde" initial Q looks like Q/Gu, uncertain: Quarde ? / Guarde ?)
003.B09 [..]gt. aber nit gehal[...]
003.B10 [..]ell 7 Monnat w[...]   ("ell"/"elt"? uncertain)
003.B11 [..]mi bell[...]   (lower line cut by torn edge; only tops of letters)

== image-004.jpg (top-right tile) ==
RIGHT part of Piece B; overlaps 003 by roughly one word per line (overlap words marked in braces). Right margin of leaf preserved (lines end before edge); pencil shelfmark vertical at right ("Stams, STA, Frg. 182-1a" or similar). Hairline crack runs down from top through lines 1-5.
004.B01 {..den,} vnnd vor diſem meine vnnder:
004.B02 {Einſt}anungen haben, vnnd darinen   ("Einſtanungen" read so; could be "Einſtannungen" - minim count uncertain)
004.B03 {..b} mir biſs hero ergangen, Alſo d[az?]   (last word cut: "dz"/"daz" with z-like tail)
004.B04 {..} lang bey der Herrn ?Richtere   (last word uncertain: R/ſ initial, "-ichtere")
004.B05 {..} gedient, vnnd ?ſonderlich vor 5   (middle word uncertain; letters look like "bngerenlich"/"ſonderlich")
004.B06 {..at} widerumben dieſes ſommers?,   ("dieſes" with long s; last word ?ſommers/ſammdez)
004.B07 {..} mir der ?Veldwaibl ?ſell derſelben   (word after "der" reads "Veldwaibl"/"Velder waibl"; next word unsure)
004.B08 {Q}uarde Verwalter, ?einen ?Plaz zu[...]   ("einen" uncertain: looks "Amer"/"Anier"; "Plaz"/"Platz")
004.B09 {..}nit gehalten worden, daſs ich alſo
004.B10 {..M}onnat wardten müeſſen, b[...]
004.B11 [..] ... der ?Zeiten [..]   (bottom line torn; only "der" and a word starting with Z/L clear)

Joined reading of Piece B (003 + 004), physical lines:
B01 [..]rnung befunden, vnnd vor diſem meine vnnder:
B02 [..]ge ſchreiben Einſtanungen haben, vnnd darinen
B03 [..]omen wie ich mir biſs hero ergangen, Alſo d[az]
B04 [..]ich die Zeit lang bey der Herrn ?Richtere
B05 [..]erhalten vnnd gedient, vnnd ?ſonderlich vor 5
B06 [..] 5. Monnath widerumben dieſes ?ſommers,
B07 [..]l beſach, das mir der ?Veldwaibl ?ſell derſelben
B08 [..]l den H: Quarde Verwalter, ?einen ?Plaz zu[..]
B09 [..]gt. aber nit gehalten worden, daſs ich alſo
B10 [..]ell 7 Monnat wardten müeſſen, b[..]
B11 [..]mi bell[..] .. der ?Zeiten [..]
(Note: in B05/B06 "vor 5" at line end and "5. Monnath" at next line start might be the same number repeated at line break or "vor 5 / [Jahren?] 5 Monnath" - left words of B06 lost.)

== image-002.jpg (top-left tile) - Piece A ==
Piece A: paper scrap with a vertical tear/crack through its middle (repaired with tape at top and centre). Most of the surface is covered by two grey rectangles (image masking) - whatever lies under them is not visible. Visible text: 3 lines of faint, small Latin cursive at the top, written across the crack; area between and below the masks appears blank paper (a faint pencil/offset mark lower centre, not text). Pencil shelfmark at bottom: "Stams, STA, Frg. 182-3a" (last character uncertain).
Contrast crop made: rscratch/packet-15/p02_top_contrast.png
002.A01 iudice , ?cuiuslibet ?alii in   (first word clear "iudice"; second word letters c-u-u/n-g?-l-?-b-i-t, read tentatively; could also be "?ſurgebit"; last two "ali(i)" with abbreviation stroke? and "in" with stroke)
002.A02 vitā(m) aeternā(m) , alii in op-   ("vitã" with tilde over a; "aeternã"; "ali'" ending)
002.A03 probriū(m) .   ("probriũ" - read as "-probriu(m)" with macron; line ends with point)
Note: "op-/probriu(m)" is split at line end in the image. Lines continue from text above the leaf's top? Line 1 begins at the left edge with "iudice", so the start of the sentence is on a previous leaf/line lost.
Remaining unread: none visible; the masked areas cannot be read.

== image-006.jpg (middle-centre tile) ==
Overlaps: top shows Piece B lines B09-B11 (left part, same as 003 bottom) and edge of Piece A (left). Bottom right shows top-left corner of Piece C.
Piece B, repeated lines (overlap with 003, not new text): B09 "[..]gt, aber nit gehal[..]"; B10 "[..]elb 7 Monnat [..]" (first word here looks "elb"/"ell" - still uncertain); B11 "[..]meni bell[..]" - first word looks like "meni"/"meine"(?), second "bell.."/"bez.." cut by tear.
Piece C, first three lines, left part (left edge of leaf cuts letters):
006.C01 Deꝰ ſolꝰ eſt rebꝰ oībꝰ p[...]   (Deus solus est rebus omnibus; "oibꝰ" with macron = o(mn)ibus)
006.C02 [..]m } Notandum, magnam[...]   (a closing brace/bracket after "m")
006.C03 [ſ]piritualiā ; quia cætera[...]   ("ſpiritualia" with a mark over final a)

== image-007.jpg (middle-right tile) ==
Top: Piece B lower lines (overlap with 004): B09 "..nit gehalten worden, das ich alſo"; B10 "..onnat wardten müeſſen, b.."; B11 "[..] .. dere ?Zeiten [..]" (here the word before reads "dere"/"der e"; second word "Zeiten"/"Leiten"? uncertain); below B11 only tops of tall letters of a further line B12 survive (unreadable, cut by tear).
Bottom: Piece C top portion, right part. Shelfmark pencil "Stams, STA, Frg. 182-2a" at top of Piece C.
Main column (right part; continues 006):
007.C01 [..]t rebꝰ oībꝰ p̄ſens, quia eſt   ("p̄ſens" = p(rae)ſens)
007.C02 [..]dum, magnam eſſe differentiam
007.C03 [..]i quia cætera ſpiritualia ag[...]   (last word runs into the marginal block: "ag" + ?)
Marginal/added block to the right, set off by a vertical rule (smaller script, same or similar ink):
007.M01 aut tn̄ alibi doceat   (tn̄ = t(ame)n; "doceat" read with underline? word underlined/struck? - a stroke under "doceat")
007.M02 operationem eſſe ra(ti)onem   ("operaīoem"/"operatōem" abbreviated; "racoem"/"rationem")
007.M03 [?a]gendi in loco, p(er) virtut(em)   (first letters run into C03 "ag-"; so C03 may be "ag-|gendi"? uncertain whether margin starts with "gendi" continuing "ag" of main line)

== image-010.jpg (bottom-right tile) - Piece C right part, full height ==
Main text, right parts of lines (line starts on 009; numbering continues C01..):
010.C01 [..]t rebꝰ oībꝰ p̄ſens, quia eſt   (overlap 007)
010.C02 [..]dum, magnam eſſe differentiam   (overlap 007)
010.C03 [..]i quia cætera ſpiritualia ag[..]   (end of "ag-" collides with marginal block; perhaps "agūt"/"ag-" - unclear)
010.C04 [..]m in quod operentur : Deꝰ
010.C04a (interlinear, below C04 at left, small) [..]gnōs?/[..]gmꝰ?   (only end visible here; see 009)
010.C05 [..]s rebꝰ, quia eas ipſe producit
010.C06 [..] aliqđ in Deo mutatur, aut   (aliq(ui)d)
010.C07 [..] rebꝰ à Deo producitur .
010.C08 [..]initate et immenſitate Dei ; ſcđm   (ſ(ecundu)m - "ſdm"/"ſcm" with stroke)
010.C09 [..]tringi ad certum locum, ut
010.C10 [..]đ Deꝰ nec circumſcriptivè
010.C11 [..]repletivè ſcđm ſbſtam et operatōe   (ſ(ecundu)m ſ(u)b(stanti)am et operat(i)o(n)e(m))
010.C12 [..] ꝺ ex parte Dei, ſꝫ ex parte   (first sign = n(on)? abbrev.; ſꝫ = ſ(ed))
010.C13 [..]equit ullo modo conſiſtere .
010.C14 [..]ſuſ? ſine continua applicat(i)o(n)e   (last word "applicaōe"; bottom line, letters at bottom edge)
Marginal block (right of vertical rule, beside C02-C05):
010.M01 aut tn̄ alibi doceat   (t(ame)n; "doceat" with a stroke beneath - underline or deletion uncertain)
010.M02 operaōem eſſe raōem   (operat(i)o(n)em eſſe rat(i)o(n)em)
010.M03 [a]gendi in loco, ꝑ virtua-   (p(er))
010.M04 lem ꝯtactū ſcil: adeoq(ue)   ("ꝯtactu" read as con-tactu(m); first letters "ſtactu" possible)
010.M05 p̄ſentia p̄ſupponi operati[..]   (p(rae)ſentia p(rae)ſupponi operati(oni)? - word end at the leaf edge)
Lines below C14 not present (leaf ends). Right side of leaf below the marginal block is blank.

== image-009.jpg (bottom-centre tile) - Piece C left part, full height ==
Left edge of Piece C is a cut edge: some line beginnings lost (letters clipped).
009.C01 Deꝰ ſolꝰ eſt rebꝰ oībꝰ p[..]
009.C02 [..]m } Notandum, magnam
009.C03 [ſ]piritualiā ; quia cætera
009.C04 [.] extrinſecum in quod op[erentur]
009.C04a (interlinear, smaller, between C04 and C05, at left) [..]ia rebꝰ ?ignotis   (second word "rebꝰ"; third "itguus"/"ignotis"? uncertain)
009.C05 Deꝰ [ſ?]præſens rebꝰ, quia   (a long bracket-like stroke rises from before "præſens" down to an insertion mark in C06)
009.C06 [.]nec [struck word, ?ideo/?dein] aliqđ in Deo   (word struck through with heavy line; above it, interlinear "tn̄"/"tm" inserted = t(ame)n?)
009.C07 [struck: creaturis] rebꝰ à Deo   (first word heavily struck through; looks like "creaturis")
009.C08 [..]ſio in infinitate et im[menſitate]
009.C09 aut conſtringi ad ce[rtum]
009.C10 [..]c fit quod Deꝰ nec
009.C11 loco ſꝫ repletivè ſ[cđm]   ("ſꝫ" = ſ(ed))
009.C12 [..]atiæ non ꝺ? ex parte De[i]   (sign after "non" like a looped d/abbrev.; perhaps e(st)? unresolved)
009.C13 [..]tia Dei nequit ullo m[odo]
009.C14 [..]a impreſſuſ ſine cont[inua]

== Joined reading of Piece C main text (009 left + 010 right) ==
C01 Deꝰ ſolꝰ eſt rebꝰ oībꝰ p̄ſens, quia eſt
C02 [..]m } Notandum, magnam eſſe differentiam

C04 [.] extrinſecum in quod operentur : Deꝰ

Marginal addition (right column, set off by rule) joined: "aut tn̄ alibi doceat / operaōem eſſe raōem / [a]gendi in loco, ꝑ virtua- / lem ꝯtactū ſcil: adeoq(ue) / p̄ſentia p̄ſupponi operati[..]"
